name: mmust-emporium-hackathon
description: AFYAROOT is an offline-first, multi-channel **AI Health Operating System** designed to support patients in rural and low-connectivity environments. Unlike generic chatbots, AFYAROOT links SMS, Web PWAs, and local facility registries into a unified health journey that remembers patient history, evaluates safety concerns like Gender-Based Violence (GBV), verifies medicines, and routes requests to specialized medical AI agents.
